items.definition:
an opinion or conclusion formed on the basis of incomplete information
His theory was based on pure conjecture rather than solid evidence.

a person who campaigns vigorously for political, social, or religious change
She became a crusader for environmental protection.

the study of families and the tracing of their lineages and history
She spent years researching her family's genealogy.

belief or opinion contrary to orthodox religious (especially Christian) doctrine
Galileo was accused of heresy for his scientific views.

a viral disease causing eruptions of the skin or mucous membranes
Herpes is a common viral infection.

a period of prolonged and intensive questioning or investigation
The police subjected him to a lengthy inquisition about his whereabouts.

a broad sash worn with a Japanese kimono
She tied the colorful obi around her kimono.

the record of the descent of an animal, showing it to be purebred
The dog had an impressive pedigree.

skill or expertise in a particular activity or field
His athletic prowess was evident on the field.

the feminine, dark, and negative principle in nature
Yin and yang represent opposing but complementary forces.

attachment or commitment to a person, cause, or belief
Strict adherence to the rules is required.

a partial or total loss of memory
After the accident, he suffered from amnesia.

the act of rising to an important position or a higher level
His ascension to the throne was celebrated.

a poet, traditionally one who composes and recites epic or heroic verse
Shakespeare is often referred to as 'the Bard'.

A continuous attack with bombs, shells, or other missiles; or a continuous flow of questions, criticisms, or information.
The city endured a heavy bombardment for several days.

The act or process of checking and adjusting the accuracy of a measuring instrument.
The machine requires regular calibration to ensure accurate readings.

The mental action or process of acquiring knowledge and understanding through thought, experience, and the senses.
The study of cognition explores how the brain processes information.

Great destruction or damage.
The earthquake caused widespread devastation in the region.

unborn or unhatched offspring
The embryo develops rapidly in the early stages of pregnancy.

lack of good sense; foolishness
It was sheer folly to attempt the climb without proper equipment.

understanding an event after it has happened
In hindsight, I should have taken a different route.

dislike of or prejudice against homosexual people
Education is key to combating homophobia in society.

military weapons, ammunition, equipment, and stores
The factory produces various types of munition.

the inescapable agent of someone's or something's downfall; a long-standing rival
The villain was finally defeated by his nemesis.

the people living in a particular country or area
The government needs to listen to the concerns of the populace.

the action of widely spreading and promoting an idea, theory, etc.; the breeding of specimens by natural processes from the parent stock
The propagation of plants can be done through seeds or cuttings.

a head of a university or school; a clergyman in charge of a parish
The new rector was welcomed by the entire university staff.

the absence of standards of absolute and universal application; the dependence of a physical phenomenon on the observer's relative motion
Einstein's theory of relativity changed our understanding of the universe.

a soft luster on a surface
The silk fabric had a beautiful sheen.

the action or crime of making a false spoken statement damaging to a person's reputation
He sued the newspaper for slander.

a large fish, some species of which are a source of caviar
The sturgeon is a prehistoric-looking fish.

an anonymous person
The message was sent by an anon.

A place where relief pitchers warm up in baseball; a shared office space.
The manager called a pitcher from the bullpen.

A fortress protecting a city.
The ancient citadel stood proudly on the hill.

The policy of acquiring full or partial political control over another country.
Many countries suffered under the weight of colonialism for centuries.

The feeling that someone or something is unworthy of one's consideration or respect.
She looked at him with utter disdain.

A ridiculous sham; a mockery.
The trial was a complete farce.

An unorthodox or independent-minded person.
He was a maverick in the industry, always challenging the status quo.

A compound resembling opium in addictive properties or physiological effects.
The doctor prescribed an opioid for severe pain.

A bacterium, virus, or other microorganism that can cause disease.
Handwashing helps prevent the spread of pathogens.

The condition of being considered more important than someone or something else; priority in importance, order, or rank.
Safety takes precedence over speed in this project.

A forecast of the likely course of a disease or ailment; a forecast of the likely outcome of a situation.
The doctor gave a good prognosis for her recovery.

a military prison, especially on a ship
The sailor was sent to the brig for insubordination.

the design and manufacture of fashionable clothes to a client's specific requirements
The fashion show featured the latest haute couture designs.

the characteristic spirit of a culture, era, or community
The company's ethos emphasizes innovation and customer satisfaction.

the spontaneous expulsion of a fetus; a failure to achieve the intended result
The court ruled it a miscarriage of justice.

the state of being unaware or forgotten
His early works have faded into oblivion.

a person whose sexual behavior is considered abnormal and unacceptable
The police arrested the man for acting like a pervert in public.

the desire to promote the welfare of others, especially by donating money
His philanthropy has helped fund many educational programs.

a person suffering from a chronic mental disorder with abnormal or violent social behavior
The character in the movie was portrayed as a dangerous psychopath.

a meeting at an agreed time and place
They planned a secret rendezvous at the cafe.

a contemptible or despicable person
He called the thief a scumbag for stealing from the elderly.

church council
The synod met to discuss new church policies.

ability to adapt or be adapted to many different functions or activities
The versatility of the new software makes it very useful.

a deviation from what is normal or usual
The doctor found an abnormality in the test results.

a sharp projection; a hurtful remark
The fishhook had a sharp barb.

a projecting part of a fortification; a stronghold
The old castle was a bastion of defense.

a recognized autonomous branch of the Christian Church; a unit of money
The machine only accepts coins of certain denominations.

an official ban on trade or other commercial activity with a particular country
The government imposed an embargo on arms sales.

a tangible or visible form of an idea, quality, or feeling
She was the embodiment of grace and elegance.

the holding of extreme political or religious views
The rise of extremism is a global concern.

the process of injecting liquid at high pressure into subterranean rocks to force open existing fissures and extract oil or gas
Environmental groups are concerned about the impact of fracking.

a mythical multi-headed serpent; a freshwater polyp
The hero had to fight the Lernaean Hydra.

an active revolt or uprising
The government is trying to suppress the insurgency.
